plain_text:
Hal Peary appears in 340 recordings across 9 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1934 to 1979. The credits here include performer and guest.

In this archive, you will hear Hal Peary most often in The Great Gildersleeve, Fibber McGee and Molly, Sealtest Variety Theater, Sears Radio Theater, CBS Radio Workshop, Calling All Cars, Duffy's Tavern, and Lux Radio Theatre.

Characters credited here include Throckmorton P. Gildersleeve.
